content.title: 图形赛道｜穿越圆门、障碍升级与单人收束
content.summary: 同一主体把抽象图形空间当作路线，跨门、分解障碍、最终独立展示结果。

quick_start.input_format: 单一主体＋可穿行图形路线＋圆门＋两障碍＋成果定格
quick_start.recommended_input: 一名成年钴蓝工作服递送员、一个琥珀发光包裹、米白几何展厅、抽象条形墙、钴蓝圆门、两道泡棉安全挡板、发光展示台。
required_anchors: 图形成为真实可走结构
终点结果与单人姿态稳定
usage_steps: 把示例主体、场景和表层元素替换为原创概念。
让每个必需锚点和 Creative DNA 不可变条件都能在画面因果链中被看见。
选择 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 模板，只填写已声明的可替换项。
生成前检查时长、事件顺序、镜头连续性、声音和反复制约束。
applicable_scope: 同一主体把抽象图形空间当作路线，跨门、分解障碍、最终独立展示结果。
能够保留全部必需锚点的原创 4–15 秒短片。
需要可复用因果视频结构的 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 项目。
not_suitable_for: 要求复制来源人物、场景、道具、对白或镜头顺序的任务。
无法在目标时长内展示全部必需锚点的概念。
缺少紧凑因果链的长篇讲解或无关多地点叙事。

creative_dna.mechanism: A single color-locked lead travels through a graphic environment that behaves as a course: oversized planar signs, directional graphic gates, spatial reset, denser multi-object obstacle interval and solo final poster. Preserve progressive route and graphic-to-spatial coupling, not the source typography, outfit or violence.

invariants.rule: Identify one lead with a persistent silhouette/accent color before moving through the oversized graphic course.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without one stable lead, rapid zones seem unrelated.

invariants.rule: Make two or more graphic structures function as traversable space and use one circular gate as a visible transition.
invariants.purpose: Gives the course a specific graphic-motion grammar.
invariants.ablation_failure: If graphics remain mere overlays, travel lacks environmental stakes.

invariants.rule: After a short identity reset, raise density with multiple obstacles and then isolate the lead in a held final frame.
invariants.purpose: Provides escalation and decisive visual closure.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without reset and isolation, the climax becomes uninterrupted action noise.

slots.name: accent_color
slots.constraint: Single stable subject accent distinct from source red.

slots.name: obstacles
slots.constraint: Readable multi-object challenge, no injury required.

slots.name: final_display
slots.constraint: Solo stable end frame with no copied wordmark.

anti_copy_exclusions: No source title, wordmark, exact English letterform walls or typography layout.
No source character face, hair, red trousers, fight poses or opponent designs.
Do not imply original source sound or precise portal lore was verified.

instantiations.concept: An adult urban wayfinding courier in cobalt workwear carries a glowing parcel through an original geometric exhibition course. Scale-changing floor stripes and a neutral circle gate lead through connected corridors. She walks around a slow side-closing padded barrier, then crouches under a raised foam beam whose lower edge stays safely above her crouched height. Without collision she places the parcel on a lit pedestal and stands alone in a clean final display frame.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Cobalt courier, geometric exhibition route, circle gate, two safety barriers, lit pedestal.

instantiations.concept: An adult swimmer in an abstract dry-land training film runs between oversized wave diagrams, passes a circular timing arch, dodges two moving foam obstacles and ends beside a completed lap counter. All visual language is original and no rival is harmed.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Dry-land swimmer training, wave diagrams, timing arch, foam obstacles, lap counter.

failure_modes.repair: Hold same cobalt uniform and parcel throughout.
Show lead approaching, crossing and emerging in a new but connected lane.

failure_modes.failure: Multiple obstacles merge into a battle scene.
failure_modes.repair: Show two distinct moving barriers, no opponent or physical strike.

failure_modes.failure: Final frame is only moving text.
failure_modes.repair: Hold performer and completed pedestal result in a readable stable composition.
